latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of 抖音信息提取器 (gnview):

- Provides API endpoints for extracting video and user information from Bilibili.
- Supports single video, video stream URLs, user posts, collections, popular videos, comments, and replies.
- Includes endpoints for live room and streaming data, user profile, dynamic posts, and danmaku (弹幕).
- Configuration handled via config.json for API host and version settings.
- All endpoints have bilingual (Chinese/English) documentation and example parameters.
